about:
Advanced Metal Art is a family-owned manufacturer of personalized metal home decor based in Orlando, Florida. The company emphasizes American-made production, though its website also references Idaho in some branding. No founding year or founder names are disclosed.

The shop produces a wide range of laser-cut and powder-coated metal pieces, including monograms, address plaques, flags, sports-themed items, faith-based sayings, and wildlife scenes. Production relies on fiber lasers and CO2 lasers, with a live preview tool for custom designs. The company offers a 48-hour rush production option and serves both retail customers and wholesale buyers. Specific facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are not published.

Primary customers are consumers seeking custom metal art for home display, along with wholesale partners in the home decor and gift markets. The company cites thousands of certified reviews, an A+ BBB rating, and a large social media following as indicators of market reach.

All items are laser cut and powder coated for durability.

name: Advanced Molding
about:
Advanced Molding operates two facilities in West Michigan, with its primary 53,000-square-foot plant in Grand Haven and a second site in Nunica. The company is led by President Matt Jacobs, Engineering Manager Steve Johnson, and Operations Manager Eric Jacobs.

The firm specializes in custom injection molding with press capacities ranging from 110 to 1,100 tons, supported by 6-axis and 3-axis robotics, pickers, and conveyors. Core processes include insert molding, automated part production, and a suite of value-added services such as annealing, kitting, labeling, taping, light assembly, sonic welding, and heat staking. The company also provides full product development — part design, tool and mold design, material selection, automation cell creation, and patent development — alongside manufacturing operations, quality management, and supply chain procurement.

Advanced Molding serves customers in outdoor recreation and sporting goods, home appliances and electrical components, agricultural equipment, B2B products, and light industrial parts. From its Michigan base, it ships parts domestically to locations such as Kalamazoo and Elkhart, Indiana, and internationally to Mexico and Europe.

The company emphasizes "breakthrough thinking and agile collaboration," aiming to engineer quality in and costs out through advanced technology and streamlined manufacturing. Its differentiators include in-house automation, a broad press range, and end-to-end services from concept to global delivery.

name: AdvancedPCB
old_description: Leading Provider of Telecom Circuit Solutions and Network PCBs
about:
AdvancedPCB is an American-based printed circuit board manufacturer headquartered in Maple Grove, Minnesota. The company operates domestic manufacturing facilities and provides engineering oversight for both prototype and volume production.

AdvancedPCB offers a full spectrum of PCB services, including fabrication of standard (0-10 layer), advanced (up to 40 layers), HDI, rigid-flex (4-22 layers), and heavy copper boards, as well as quick-turn prototypes with turnaround as fast as 24 hours. Its assembly division handles SMT, through-hole, and mixed-technology builds with turnkey, partial turnkey, or consigned parts options and no minimum order quantity. The company also provides design services for high-speed digital, RF, and HDI circuits, DFM reviews, and global manufacturing through certified offshore partners with U.S. engineering oversight.

The company serves aerospace and defense, telecommunications and networking, data centers and cloud computing, industrial and robotics, medical devices, automotive, consumer electronics, and computing/AI hardware sectors. Customers range from defense primes requiring AS9100 and ITAR compliance to commercial OEMs scaling from prototype to high-volume production.

AdvancedPCB emphasizes its integrated domestic fabrication and assembly under one roof to reduce handoff risk, military-grade security with ITAR-compliant data handling, and a 'Made in America' model that ships worldwide. The firm also highlights rapid prototyping offers such as same-day turns and weekend delivery programs to accelerate R&D cycles.

name: AeroLEDs, LLC
about:
AeroLEDs, LLC is based in Boise, Idaho, and was founded in 2006 with a mission to redefine modern LED aerospace lighting. The company entered a market that had seen little change in 50 years and introduced the first LED-based airplane lights, raising the bar for performance and quality.

The company designs and manufactures a range of LED lighting solutions for aircraft, including wingtip and tail lights, landing, taxi, and recognition lights, and beacons. It also produces specialized experimental lighting and STC‑approved LED kits for jets and turboprops. Manufacturing processes include aluminum heat‑sink fabrication with black powder coating and integrated lighting‑system assembly. Installations span experimental and Part 23 aircraft through to space and military programs, with products fielded on over 15 tactical military platforms.

AeroLEDs serves the general aviation, business jet, turboprop, military, and space sectors. Its customer base includes experimental aircraft builders (notably the Vans RV community), operators of certified jets and turboprops, and military programs requiring both overt and covert lighting solutions.

The business was started because the aerospace lighting market was stagnant and in drastic need of a new product with a fresh look and unequaled performance. By creating the first LED‑based airplane lights, AeroLEDs forced legacy manufacturers to respond and moved aircraft lighting from a forgotten necessity to a desired accessory.

name: Affordable Furniture
old_description: Affordable Furniture Manufacturing, Inc. is one of the largest
about:
Affordable Furniture Manufacturing, Inc. commenced operations in 2004 in Houlka, Mississippi, as a privately owned domestic supplier specializing in promotional upholstered furniture. The company was established with a focus on becoming a true low-cost producer while maintaining quality at a very reasonable price through manufacturing efficiencies.

The business now operates over 600,000 square feet of manufacturing facilities in Houlka and employs more than 300 dedicated workers. Its extensive product offering includes stationary upholstery, motion upholstery, leather upholstery, recliners, sleepers, sectionals, sofas, loveseats, chairs, ottomans, chaises, accent pieces, and tables. By maintaining finished goods inventory on every item, the company ships orders immediately from stock.

Affordable Furniture serves the furniture industry, supplying dealers who sell to end consumers. The trade recognizes the company as a customer-oriented, low-cost leader in stationary upholstery, motion upholstery, and recliners. Its customer base includes furniture retailers and distributors seeking promotional upholstered products.

The company says its differentiation lies in manufacturing efficiencies that translate to value for dealers and consumers, combined with a stock-and-ship model that provides the industry's shortest lead times. This approach has driven growth since its inception in 2004.

name: Affordable Metal Manufacturing
about:
Affordable Metal Manufacturing operates from Muscatine, Iowa, where Billy and Brooke Wagler own and run the family-owned business. The company distributes roll-formed metal roofing and siding products across the Midwest, guided by a mission to further the Kingdom of God through its daily work and customer relationships.

The company roll-forms standing seam panels (in 1-, 1.5-, and 1.75-inch snap-lock profiles), PBR panels, Smart Rib Plus®, and board-and-batten steel siding, all cut to length on site. It also supplies trim and accessories for residential, commercial, and agricultural projects. The shop team, led by Maisy Howell, handles production while a sales and logistics crew coordinates pickup and delivery for contractors throughout Iowa and surrounding states.

Customers include residential builders, commercial contractors such as Miles Construction and Ken Morrison Construction, and agricultural operators needing durable roofing for farm buildings. Smith Building, another commercial client, cites the firm's fast turnaround and willingness to handle orders of any size.

AMM emphasizes American-made materials, a lifetime warranty, and short lead times as differentiators. Its stated values—integrity, trust, second chances, personal growth, relationships, and teamwork—frame a culture that aims to move at the “speed of trust” while providing expert advice and local support.
